layout.body: The Community Center will host a free language exchange event on Saturday at 3:00 PM. Learn a new language, meet people from different cultural backgrounds, and swap languages in a fun, flexible, and relaxed way. We will pair you with a fluent speaker of a language of your choice.

questions.analysis: What is the notice about? 原文依据：The Community Center will host a free language exchange event. 社区中心将举办一场免费的语言交流活动。 A：外语图书募捐活动 → 错误 B：社区组织会议 → 错误 C：语言交流活动 → 正确 D：学生交换项目 → 错误

options.C: Pair up with speakers of different languages

questions.analysis: What will participants NOT experience? 原文依据：Learn a new language, meet people from different backgrounds… pair you with a fluent speaker… in a fun, flexible, and relaxed way.学习一门新语言，认识不同文化背景的人…… 为你配对流利的使用者…… 以轻松有趣的方式。 A：学习新语言 → 错误 B：练习放松技巧 → 正确 C：与不同语言使用者配对 → 错误 D：认识不同文化的人 → 错误
